description: This file defines a singleton class 'DevicePairingApprovalPrompter' responsible for managing device pairing requests, presenting user alerts, handling responses, and communicating with a gateway for approval or rejection, within a macOS application.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A final class implementing singleton pattern to manage device pairing request prompts, including displaying alerts, processing user responses, and syncing with a backend gateway.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompt push task, enabling the processing of new pairing requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the push task and clears pending requests and internal states.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously requests the list of pending pairing requests from the backend gateway.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates internal queue with new pairing list, sorts requests, and triggers presentation if needed.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates counters for total pending requests and repair-specific counts.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks presentation conditions and presents the next pending request alert if applicable.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays the pairing request alert to the user for a specific request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles the user's response to the alert, managing request approval, rejection, or reordering.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for the device pairing request to the backend.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection for the device pairing request to the backend.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the current active pairing alert.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming push notifications, adding new requests or handling resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pairing request to the queue if not already present.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles a pairing request's resolution, updating internal states accordingly.
